description:
Invisible Welding Technology: The MULTIJOY EB262 is a sleek, modern electric bike for adults that stands out due to its advanced invisible welding technology. This technology enhances the bike's structural integrity, reduces loose joints, and creates a visually pleasing aesthetic. The cleverly integrated hidden battery adds to the streamlined silhouette of the e-bike, setting a new standard for electric bike design

High-Power Peak 450W Motor: Experience superior acceleration and climbing ability with our high-speed 350W (Peak 450W) brushless motor. With a torque reaching up to 40NM and a maximum speed of 20mph, this electric bike for adults offers both power and speed for an exhilarating ride

Convenient Removable Hidden Battery: The MULTIJOY EB262 features a proprietary 36V 7.8AH hidden lithium battery, providing up to 35 miles in PAS mode. Its sleek, removable design not only enhances the aesthetic of the e-bike but also offers convenience and portability. Easily removable with one hand, the battery's compact size makes it ideal for on-the-go charging

Safe & Comfortable Off-Road Riding: This ebike is equipped with 26*1.95 inch off-road tires and a professional suspension fork, ensuring a smooth and safe ride across various terrains such as sand, mud, gravel, and snow. With reliable front and rear disc brakes, your safety is our priority.This bike is UL2849 certified.

Intelligent Riding with Excellent Performance: The MULTIJOY EB262 electric mountain bike features a detailed LED 3-speed screen for smart riding. Its lightweight aluminum frame and Shimano 7-speed transmission system allow for customizable speed and easy handling. Enjoy a high-performance ride every time

UL Certification: All our electronic products, including this e-bike, have obtained UL2849 certification, ensuring quality and safety
